exposure: Manual ultrasound measurements of fetal intracranial structures
Automated 3D ultrasound measurements of fetal intracranial structures
outcome: Accuracy of automated 3D ultrasound measurements compared to manual measurements
Success rate of obtaining automated measurements
cohort: 143 pregnant women between 18 and 22 weeks' gestation
finding: Automated 3D ultrasound using SonoCNS® Fetal Brain showed good reliability for measuring biparietal diameter and head circumference but was less consistent for transcerebellar diameter, cisterna magna, and posterior horn of the lateral ventricle measurements compared to manual methods.
